author: Aaron Makings
text: As a construction working who uses portable toilets regularly, I sure do appreciate a well maintained unit. Pacific sanitation services offers the nicest and most well maintained portable toilets around. Their staff is super friendly and has the best attention to detail when it comes to maintaining the toilets!

author: Tonya Burch
text: I got a dumpster delivered for some spring cleaning. The process was great from start to finish. The driver who delivered the container was polite and professional. This is family ran business and it shows in all the best ways. I also live near an RV park that they service. I consistently drive by as the septic system is being serviced. The worker always smiles and waves. Happy and outgoing employees in the sanitation business are rare. Five stars Two thumbs up. Great people Great experience. Thank you.

author: Gina Rudman
text: Spencer is the absolute best! He often brings down heavy boxes of dog food for us from our gate on his way in and he’s just the nicest guy ever!!! Thanks for being awesome Spencer!

author: Murdock
text: Robert and Sarah are great to work with and professional in every aspect when reporting to my job sites. I have used Pacific for years now for portable toilets and dumpsters and consider Pacific top notch! Don't hesitate to call them you'll be glad you did!

author: James Gaffney
text:
If you are looking for reliable porta potty services look no further than Pacific Sanitation. We use them for all of our roofing jobs and they are hands down the best company we have ever dealt with. In the past we struggled with other companies where every delivery was a hassle but Pacific Sanitation has completely changed the game for us.

A huge part of that success is Toni. She does a phenomenal job and is always on top of every single detail. Deliveries and pickups happen exactly when scheduled and her communication ensures everything runs smoothly. This level of customer service is getting harder and harder to find these days and we truly appreciate their business. As long as we are in business Pacific Sanitation is our go to company for porta potties.
